title: Updating an entry of the drop-value vector
statement: Let $n,p,z,s,u,f,q,t,a$ and $b$ be natural numbers, and let $r$ be an index from $0$ to $8$. Replacing entry $r$ of $(p,n,z,s,u,f,q,t,a)$ by $b$ gives the vector whose entries are respectively $b$ when their indices equal $r$, and otherwise are the original entries.
hypotheses_covered: Natural numbers n, p, z, s, u, f, q, t, a, and b
